description: First file-name parser did not match 188 file names (lower case, spaces, underscores, 6-digit dates).
impact: None; parser corrected before any manifest was used.
action: Normalised case/space/underscore; accepted 6- or 8-digit dates; 0 non-matching after the fix.

description: First manifest build used content-hash sample IDs; the byte-identical duplicate pair produced duplicated IDs and a many-to-many merge (788 rows instead of 786).
impact: None; detected before splits were made.
action: Path-based sample IDs; exact duplicate excluded (D-002); 785 recordings.

description: Management-file writer crashed (format arguments out of order).
First Stage C run: T05 failed (wrong expected balanced accuracy in the test itself) and T07b failed (the instrumentation read column 0, which is not the row id after feature selection).
impact: None on the pipeline; both were errors in the tests.
action: Expected value corrected; T07b instrumented on the all-features condition and T07c kept for selection; 25 of 25 passed.

description: FWL could not be run: purpose, response, nuisance covariates, residualization, statistic and stopping rule are undefined.
Runner gate 'protocol_and_split_hashes_match_freeze' compared the freeze record with itself (always true).
impact: None: the OOF audit verified the on-disk protocol and split hashes independently (check 7 passed).
action: Gate now hashes the files on disk; documented in OPUS_AUDIT.md.

description: The two-digit file-name number was described as age; extraction time and run-time units misstated; some report wording overstated.
Copied top WavLM layers inherited requires_grad=False from the frozen base model, so only the linear head was trained. Detected because two learning rates gave identical inner AUPRC at every epoch.
impact: None on results; aborted during fold 1 before any fold was saved. Log kept as s13_finetune_ABORTED_head_only_bug.log.
action: Copied layers and layer norm set trainable; run now stops if trainable weights differ from the expected count or if the trained layers do not change; restarted from scratch.
